sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... UPR FLOW REGIME WILL BECOME MORE PROGRESSIVE ON SUNDAY AS THE UPR LOW AND ASSOCD TROUGH OVER THE ROCKIES/WRN STATES BEGIN TO EJECT ENE. NUMEROUS MID-LVL IMPULSES EMBEDDED IN A DOWNSTREAM BELT OF MODEST FLOW WILL CONTINUE TO TRAVEL FROM THE CNTRL ROCKIES ACROSS THE GRTLKS REGION AND INTO THE NERN STATES THROUGH THE PD. AT THE SFC...LOW OVER THE UPR MS VLY WILL DEVELOP ENE INTO SWRN ONTARIO BY SUNDAY EVENING WITH A WRMFNT TRANSLATING NWD FROM THE MIDWEST/OH VLY INTO LWR GRTLKS/MID-ATLC CSTL REGIONS. TRAILING THE LOW...A CDFNT WILL SETTLE SLOWLY SEWD THROUGH THE UPR MIDWEST...CORN BELT AND CNTRL PLNS THROUGH 12Z MONDAY.

sections.title: CNTRL PLNS NEWD TO THE CNTRL GRTLKS REGION
sections.text: LARGELY ELEVATED BANDS/CLUSTERS OF TSTMS WILL BE ONGOING OVER THE CNTRL GRTLKS REGION SUNDAY MORNING...TIED TO A MID-LVL IMPULSE AND ENHANCED MOISTURE TRANSPORT. A FEW OF THESE STORMS WILL PRODUCE LARGE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS THROUGH THE MORNING OVER PARTS OF NRN LWR MI/UPR MI BEFORE MOVING DOWNSTREAM INTO ONTARIO. MEANWHILE...NEXT IN A SERIES OF SHORTWAVE TROUGHS...CURRENTLY OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS...WILL MOVE ENE...REACHING THE CORN BELT AND UPR MS VLY BY SUNDAY AFTN. THIS IMPULSE WILL STRENGTHEN THE FRONTAL CIRCULATION FROM PARTS OF SRN WI SWWD TO NERN KS DURING THE AFTN AND RESULT IN A GRADUAL INCREASE IN DEEP MOIST CONVECTION. REGION WILL REMAIN IN A VERY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT FEATURING VERY STEEP MID-LVL LAPSE RATES AND RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE. MAJORITY OF THE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE LOCATED N OF THE FRONT...BUT GIVEN INSTABILITY IN PLACE AND AT LEAST 30-35 KTS OF MID-LVL FLOW...SUPERCELLS CANNOT BE RULED OUT WITH VERY LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO. DEEP LAYER WSW FLOW WILL BE DECIDEDLY UNIDIRECTIONAL ALONG THE LENGTH OF THE FRONT. THUS...WHILE SPLITTING SUPERCELLS MAY BE POSSIBLE EARLY IN THE INITIATION PD...EXPECT THAT INCREASING UPDRAFT COMPETITION AND MERGERS

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: CDFNT WILL SURGE TO THE CO/NM BORDER EARLY SUNDAY MORNING. IN ITS WAKE...UPSLOPE FLOW WILL MAINTAIN/ADVECT UPR 40S TO MID 50S SFC DEW POINT TO THE CO/WY HIGHER TERRAIN. STEEP LAPSE RATES AND POST-FRONTAL HEATING WILL YIELD AROUND 1000 J/KG CAPE DURING THE AFTN. DIURNAL MOUNTAIN TSTM INITIATION WILL BE ENHANCED AS THE BASE OF THE EJECTING UPR TROUGH ARRIVES SUNDAY AFTN WITH ACTIVITY GROWING INTO SUPERCELLS AS BASES ROOT INTO THE HIGH PLAINS INSTABILITY. MAGNITUDE OF LAPSE RATES...VERTICAL SHEAR 40-45 KTS AND MODEST UPR SUPPORT WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR ROBUST STORMS WITH VERY LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A TORNADO.

sections.title: MID-ATLC REGION/NY STATE
sections.text: MID-LVL IMPULSE MOVING INTO THE UPR MS VLY REGION IS EXPECTED TO TURN ESE AND MOVE ACROSS THE NRN MID-ATLC REGION/NY STATE SUNDAY AFTN. CONSIDERABLE MORNING CONVECTION/CLOUDS WILL REINFORCE THE WRMFNT AND SUSPECT MODELS MAY BE TOO FAR N WITH AFTN FRONTAL PLACEMENT. INFLUX OF UPR 60S TO AROUND 70 DEG F SFC DEW POINTS AND MODEST INSOLATION IN THE EXPANDING WARM SECTOR WILL RESULT IN AROUND 1500 J/KG MLCAPE...MOST LIKELY FROM WRN NY SEWD TOWARD ERN PA/NJ. WNWLY FLOW IN EXCESS OF 30 KTS ATOP SWLY FLOW IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER WILL BOOST DEEP LAYER SHEAR TO 45 KTS. EXPECT THAT STRONGER STORMS WILL EVENTUALLY EVOLVE ALONG SRN PERIPHERY OF ANY EARLY DAY CONVECTION/CLOUDS WITH BOTH SUPERCELL AND FAST MOVING LINE SEGMENTS POSSIBLE GIVING LARGE HAIL...DMGG WINDS AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO. ..RACY/JEWELL.. 08/09/2009

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LAST MAJOR PORTION OF ERN GRT BASIN/CNTRL RCKYS TROUGH WILL EJECT ENE INTO THE NRN PLNS LATER TODAY AND INTO THE UPR MS VLY EARLY MON AS RDG PERSISTS OVER THE SERN STATES. AHEAD OF THE MAIN TROUGH... SATELLITE AND MODEL DATA SHOW A SERIES OF WEAKER DISTURBANCES IN BRANCH OF FLOW THAT EXTENDS FROM THE SRN RCKYS AND CNTRL PLNS INTO THE UPR MS VLY...THE GRT LKS...AND THE NORTHEAST. THESE LIKELY WILL MODULATE STORM DEVELOPMENT IN THOSE REGIONS THROUGH THE PERIOD. AT LWR LVLS...LOW OVER THE UPR GRT LKS WILL MOVE GENERALLY E INTO SRN QUEBEC BY EARLY MON...WITH ASSOCIATED WARM FRONT MOVING/ REDEVELOPING E ACROSS THE LWR GRTLKS/MID ATLANTIC REGION TODAY...AND THROUGH MOST OF NEW ENGLAND BY 12Z MON. TRAILING THE LOW...A COLD FRONT WILL SETTLE SLOWLY SE ACROSS THE UPR GRT LKS AND PARTS OF THE UPR MS VLY/CNTRL PLNS THROUGH THE PERIOD.

sections.title: CNTRL PLNS TO CNTRL GRT LKS
sections.text: STORM CLUSTER NOW IN ERN NEB/WRN IA...AND/OR NEW DEVELOPMENT IN ITS VICINITY...SHOULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND STRENGTH LATER THIS MORNING AS ASSOCIATED UPR IMPULSE CONTINUES NEWD AND DOWNSTREAM BOUNDARY DESTABILIZES WITH SFC HEATING /REF WW 680 AND 681/. CONSIDERABLE SBCAPE /WITH VALUES UP TO 3000 J PER KG/ SHOULD DEVELOP ALONG/AHEAD OF COLD FRONT FROM CNTRL/ERN IA ENE INTO PARTS OF WI...NRN IL...NRN IND...NRN OH...AND LWR MI LATER TODAY. COUPLED WITH CONTINUING PRESENCE OF EML AND RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE....SETUP WILL YIELD STRONG CONVECTIVE UPDRAFTS WITH A POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL. IN ADDITION...MODERATE...LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL DEEP WSWLY FLOW SHOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR A FEW LONG-LIVED LEWPS AND/OR EWD-MOVING BOWING SEGMENTS WITH HIGH WIND. EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS MAY ALSO OCCUR...WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR A TORNADO OR TWO. REGENERATIVE/REPEAT ACTIVITY WILL ALSO BE POSSIBLE AS SUBSEQUENT UPR LVL IMPULSES TRACK ALONG ROUGHLY SAME PATH AS LEAD DISTURBANCE. BACKBUILDING STORMS COULD EXTEND SW INTO NRN KS/NRN MO...ESPECIALLY TONIGHT/EARLY MON.

sections.title: CNTRL HI PLNS
sections.text: IN WAKE OF COLD FRONT...WEAK...MOIST UPSLOPE FLOW WILL PERSIST OVER ERN CO/SE WY TODAY...ALLOWING UPR 40S TO MID 50S SFC DEW POINTS TO REACH THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF THE FRONT RANGE SND SRN WY MOUNTAINS. STEEP LAPSE RATES AND HEATING WILL YIELD AROUND 1000 J/KG SBCAPE. ALTHOUGH IT APPEARS THAT THE REGION WILL EXPERIENCE HEIGHT RISES THROUGH MUCH OF THE PERIOD AS MAIN PORTION OF UPR LOW LIFTS NE AWAY FROM REGION...TERRAIN-INDUCED CIRCULATIONS BENEATH RESIDUAL COOL POOL ALOFT SHOULD YIELD SCTD AFTN/EVE STORMS. SOME OF THESE MAY EVOLVE INTO SUPERCELLS GIVEN 40+ KT DEEP WLY SHEAR. LOW LVL SHEAR WILL BE RELATIVELY WEAK...BUT WITH A SIZABLE DIRECTIONAL COMPONENT. SETUP THUS APPEARS MOST FAVORABLE FOR LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO THROUGH LATE EVE.

sections.title: MID ATLANTIC/NORTHEAST
sections.text: APPARENT UPR IMPULSE NOW OVER NRN MI EXPECTED TO CONTINUE ESE INTO UPSTATE NY BY LATE TODAY AS SFC WARM FRONT REDEVELOPS E/ENEWD. PRECIP/CLOUDS WILL SOMEWHAT RETARD ADVANCE OF SFC WARM FRONT...ESPECIALLY OVER ERN PARTS OF PA AND NY...ALTHOUGH 850 MB BOUNDARY LIKELY WILL REACH WRN NEW ENGLAND BY EVE. INFLUX OF UPR 60S TO 70 F SFC DEW POINTS WITH MODEST HEATING SHOULD RESULT IN 1500-2000 J/KG SBCAPE...MOST LIKELY FROM WRN NY SE TOWARD SE PA/SRN NJ. 30-35 KT WNWLY MID LVL FLOW ATOP LIGHT SWLY BOUNDARY LAYER FLOW WILL HELP BOOST DEEP NWLY SHEAR TO NEAR 40 KTS. CLUSTERS OF STRONG AFTN/EVE STORMS SHOULD EVOLVE ALONG SWRN FRINGE OF EARLY DAY CLOUDS/STORMS. LEWPS AND WITH EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS AND BOWING LINE SEGMENTS MAY YIELD DMGG WIND...SVR HAIL...AND...GIVEN 2 INCH PW/LOCALLY BACKED FLOW NEARLY REMNANT BOUNDARIES...PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO. ..CORFIDI/HURLBUT.. 08/09/2009

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER ERN CO
sections.text: ...CENTRAL PLAINS INTO ERN IA/NRN IL AND SRN WI INTO PARTS OF LOWER MI... SEVERE STORM CLUSTER OVER CENTRAL IA IS EXPECTED TO PROGRESS EWD/ENEWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS. STORM SYSTEM IS CURRENTLY UNDERGOING A FLUCTUATION IN STORM STRUCTURE WITH MESOSCALE ROTATION NOTED IN RADAR IMAGERY. ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY DEVELOP ON OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF THE CURRENT ACTIVITY AS IT MOVES INTO AN INCREASING WARM...MOIST AND UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT WITH DEW POINTS IN THE LOW 70S AND MLCAPE INCREASING TO 2500-3000 J/KG THIS AFTERNOON. STRONG WSWLY WINDS ALOFT AND UNIDIRECTIONAL VERTICAL SHEAR WILL PROMOTE DEVELOPMENT OF BOWING LINE SEGMENTS THAT WILL HAVE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL. THIS ACTIVITY WILL LIKELY SPREAD ACROSS LAKE MI AND CONTINUE INTO PARTS OF LOWER MI THIS EVENING. ADDITIONAL STRONG/SEVERE STORMS ARE ALSO EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER PARTS OF NERN KS/SERN NEB AND SWRN IA LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING WHICH MAY TRACK ENEWD INTO THE WRN PART OF THE MDT RISK AREA THIS EVENING.

sections.title: NERN STATES
sections.text: A BROKEN SQUALL LINE IS MOVING ESEWD INTO PARTS OF WRN NY...AND THIS ACTIVITY IS LIKELY TO MOVE INTO PARTS OF PA AND THE DE RIVER VALLEY THROUGH THE AFTERNOON HOURS. DECREASING CLOUD COVER WEST OF THE NW/SE ORIENTED WARM FRONT WILL AID DIURNAL HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION...WITH POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL STORMS TO DEVELOP IN ADVANCE OF THE CONVECTIVE LINE. NWLY FLOW AND STRONG DIRECTIONAL SHEAR NEAR THE WARM FRONT WILL ENHANCE VERTICAL SHEAR WITH POTENTIAL FOR AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL OR TWO TO DEVELOP. DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS.

sections.text: WELL-DEFINED UPPER VORTICITY MAX IS MOVING ENEWD OVER ERN WY WITH LARGE SCALE ASCENT WITHIN COMMA CLOUD AHEAD OF THE VORTICITY MAX. STORMS MAY INCREASE ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE CLOUD BAND WITH STRONGER CELLS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS. .....CNTRL HI PLNS... sections.title: LOWER MO VALLEY INTO LOWER MI
sections.text: MULTIPLE MCS/S ARE ONGOING AS OF 0030Z FROM LOWER MI SWWD INTO THE LOWER MO VALLEY WITH THE MOST INTENSE SYSTEM BEING BOW ECHO PROPAGATING EWD FROM CNTRL INTO ERN IA AT AROUND 40 KT. INFLOW AIR MASS ACROSS REGION REMAINS HOT AND QUITE MOIST WITH TEMPERATURES IN THE 80S/LOWER 90S AND DEWPOINTS OF 70-75 F...CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE OF 2000-3500 J/KG. ORGANIZED COLD POOLS COUPLED WITH STRENGTHENING SWLY LLJ AND RESULTANT 35-45 KT DEEP WLY SHEAR SHOULD SUSTAIN MESOSCALE SYSTEMS TONIGHT WITH A CONTINUED THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL.

sections.title: LOWER GREAT LAKES TO MID ATLANTIC COAST
sections.text: WHILE ONE MCS IS IN THE PROCESS OF DECAYING ALONG THE NJ/DE COASTS...ANOTHER IS RAPIDLY INTENSIFYING OVER SWRN ONTARIO. WHILE BOUNDARY LAYER HAS BEEN TEMPORARILY STABILIZED IN WAKE OF INITIAL SYSTEM...STRENGTHENING WNWLY LLJ WILL SERVE TO ENHANCE THE INFLUX OF A MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS INTO THE REGION FROM THE W. THIS DESTABILIZATION IN CONJUNCTION WITH ORGANIZING COLD POOL OF ONTARIO SYSTEM SHOULD ALLOW IT TO CONTINUE SEWD THROUGH PARTS OF NY TOWARD THE MID ATLANTIC COAST WITH THE THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL.

sections.title: CNTRL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ISOLATED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING AHEAD OF SECONDARY COLD FRONT FROM NEAR HON SWWD TO VTN TO S OF SNY. 00Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS INDICATE THE PRESENCE OF A RELATIVELY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH MLCAPE OF 500-1000 J/KG. BELT OF 30-40 KT MIDLEVEL FLOW OBSERVED TO THE S OF VORTICITY MAXIMUM LIFTING NEWD THROUGH SD IS RESULTING IN 40-50 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ACROSS FRONTAL ZONE. AS SUCH...ENVIRONMENT WILL REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR THE MAINTENANCE OF ORGANIZED/ROTATING UPDRAFTS THROUGH THE REMAINDER OF THE EVENING WITH THE PRIMARY THREAT BEING HAIL. ..MEAD.. 08/10/2009
